integrity: Contains a fully specified discrete channel, explicit integer-coded witnesses, and a standalone exact enumerator with a sound mathematical pruning argument. No external mathematical certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact capacities only for integer lengths 3 through 9; no general closed formula, classification of all optimal codes, or decoding algorithm; finite exhaustive verification is not an independent mathematical audit.
title: Exact capacities of five-read binary deletion–substitution reconstruction codes through length nine
